many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

 for j in range(C):

   q=[(i,j)];seen.add((i,j)); comp=[]
   for x,y in q:

    for dx,dy in [(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]:
     X,Y=x+dx,y+dy
     if 0<=X<R and 0<=Y<C and a[X][Y]==0 and (X,Y) not in seen:seen.add((X,Y));q.append((X,Y))
   comps.append(comp)
   if len(comp)>=2:
    for x,y in comp:out[x][y]=8
